🔵 ETH Update – Watching the Structure
ETH is showing steady movement, and the structure still looks healthy. After recent volatility, buyers are trying to defend key support zones while momentum slowly builds. Compared to many altcoins, ETH continues to show relative strength, especially when BTC stabilizes.
What I’m observing is that network activity remains solid, and staking demand continues to play an important role in reducing circulating supply. If volume increases and resistance levels are broken with confidence, ETH could attempt another upward move.
At the same time, I’m staying cautious. The market can change quickly, and fake breakouts are always possible. For now, I’m watching price action closely and waiting for confirmation before making any major decisions.
In my view, ETH remains one of the strongest long-term projects in crypto.
